scope.task: Independent review of five persons_3 current null-Wikipedia profiles with same-name disambiguation

method: Recomputed each current draft/profile/evidence hash; checked evidence sidecar bindings and current knownBy against the pinned fixed WEB verse row; read Wikipedia article body at the locator recorded for each item, including similar-name and wrong-person candidates. No drafts or evidence were edited.

fixedWEB.text: Elihoreph and Ahijah, the sons of Shisha, scribes; Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud, the recorder;

articleReview.articleTitle: List of minor Hebrew Bible figures, A–K
articleReview.locator: Jehoshaphat subsection, lines 3938–3944; separate entries identify (1) son of Paruah as Issachar administrator and (2) son of Ahilud as Solomon’s recorder. Recorder (Bible), lines 102–104, independently describes the role and cites 1 Kings 4:3.
articleReview.supportParaphraseJa: 記事の同じ見出し内で二人のヨシャファトを分け、アヒルドの子をソロモンの記録官と明記します。対象は列王記上4:3の記録官で、ソロモンの別の役人ヨシャファトやユダ王とは区別できます。
articleReview.recommendation: direct article suitable; kind shared-section, identityVerified=true, relationVerified=false; gate 1KI 4:3. King Jehoshaphat page is a different person and should not be linked.

fixedWEB.text: Elihoreph and Ahijah, the sons of Shisha, scribes; Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud, the recorder;

articleReview.articleTitle: List of minor Hebrew Bible figures, A–K
articleReview.locator: Elihoreph subsection lines 2445–2449 says Elihoreph was Solomon’s court scribe, son of Shisha and brother of Ahiah, and cites 1 Kings 4:3; the article has no Shavsha entry (body search “Shavsha” no match). 1 Chronicles 18 page body search also has no Shavsha.
articleReview.supportParaphraseJa: 共有一覧は同じ節のエリホレフと父シシャを扱いますが、シャブシャを挙げず、シャブシャとシシャを同一人物とする説明もありません。記事との関係はありますが、このリンクで別綴りの同一性を断定できません。
articleReview.recommendation: No direct identity article found. If exposing a link, related-section only and note exact limits; safer current state is null pending an authorized textual witness establishing Shavsha/Shisha alias. Do not use “Shisha” disambiguation page.

fixedWEB.text: So he died according to the LORD’s word which Elijah had spoken. Jehoram began to reign in his place in the second year of Jehoram the son of Jehoshaphat king of Judah, because he had no son.

articleReview.locator: Lead/infobox lines 157–181: page explicitly says “Not to be confused with Jehoshaphat (father of Jehu),” then identifies this person as King of Judah, son of Asa, successor to Asa. Current article lines 162–181 identify the Judean king.
articleReview.supportParaphraseJa: 記事はユダ王ヨシャファトを扱い、エフーの父ヨシャファトとは別記事だと明記しています。固定本文2:17の「ユダの王ヨシャファトの子ヨラム」と役割が一致します。
articleReview.recommendation: direct identity article suitable; kind article, identityVerified=true, relationVerified=false; gate 2KI 1:17. Do not use this page for Jehu’s father.

fixedWEB.text: When you come there, find Jehu the son of Jehoshaphat the son of Nimshi, and go in and make him rise up from among his brothers, and take him to an inner room.

articleReview.locator: Lead lines 102–105 explicitly says this Jehoshaphat was Jehu’s father and Nimshi’s son, citing 2 Kings 9:2 and 9:14; line 102 distinguishes him from the king’s page.
articleReview.supportParaphraseJa: 記事はニムシの子でエフーの父であるヨシャファトを扱い、列王記下9:2・9:14を明記しています。ユダ王の人物記事とは明示的に区別されています。
articleReview.recommendation: direct identity article suitable; kind article, identityVerified=true, relationVerified=false; gate 2KI 9:2. Do not bind to the Judah king article.

fixedWEB.text: The captain of the guard took Seraiah the chief priest, Zephaniah the second priest, and the three keepers of the threshold;

articleReview.articleTitle: List of high priests of Israel
articleReview.locator: First Temple period/table, lines 156–160 and 180. The row names Seraiah, notes him contemporary with Jeconiah and Zedekiah, and explicitly cites 2 Ki 25:18. The article itself cautions lines 156–157 that the priestly lists differ and it is unclear whether every genealogical name held the office. The generic Seraiah page, lines 110–118, lists other Seraiah figures and does not identify this chief priest.
articleReview.supportParaphraseJa: 一覧表には列王記下25:18を出典とするセラヤの行があります。ただし記事は祭司の系譜・歴代一覧には異同があり、系譜中の全員が祭司長だったかは不明と留保しています。一般の「Seraiah」記事は別の同名者を列挙し、この祭司長の根拠にはなりません。
articleReview.recommendation: shared-section identity is supported by exact biblical citation; qualified because the list’s larger succession/genealogical reconstruction is explicitly disputed. Suggested kind shared-section, identityVerified=true, relationVerified=false, gate 2KI 25:18; note should only state article’s exact row and uncertainty, not overstate lineage.

limitationsJa: 閲覧は記事本文の記録済み該当箇所に限る。シャブシャについてWikipedia上に同一人物を確定する記事は確認できず、固定WEB 1KI4:3も名を「Shavsha」でなく「Shisha」と記すため、異綴りの同一視を保留する。セラヤの祭司系譜は記事自身が異同を留保する。
hashMethod: draft/evidence SHA256 over raw bytes; profile SHA256 over UTF-8 json.dumps(profile, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) plus trailing newline; verse text SHA256 over UTF-8 exact string.
